storyInfo: With Sonya and the others' help, many students are freed from their confinement. However, Gromov breaks out the heavy weapons, unleashing a wild bombardment on them. Sonya and the others return to camp, thinking about how they can overcome the weaponry gap.

attributes.content: Glug. Glug.
I watch the bubbles in the water cooler. They rise up in an unending stream, and then they pop.
Many people are walking out of the dour hall, taking advantage of the arbiter calling a recess to stretch their legs, and voice their opinions on the matter while they are at it.

In my moment of distraction, the water overflows, spilling onto the floor. The noblewoman behind me languidly moves away from the puddle, afraid the 'pure snowmelt from Sami' would damage her worn leather boots.
Bozhe moy, I once had the exact same pair...
I quickly spin my wheelchair, attempting to flee.
Varvara? Is that you?
attributes.name: Handsome Nobleman

attributes.content: I can hardly believe it. You look...
attributes.name: Handsome Nobleman

attributes.content: Help me carry these books, they're too heavy!
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: I need to save my strength for tonight's script reading—No, you can't come! This is a student group internal event.
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: ...Are you surprised?
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: No, Varvara. That's not what I mean.
attributes.name: Handsome Nobleman

attributes.content: We were childhood friends. The bond between nobles is not so easily broken.
attributes.name: Handsome Nobleman

attributes.content: Do you still think of me as a noble when you see me like this?
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: What do you—
attributes.name: Handsome Nobleman

attributes.content: Did you not hear what Zoya and that other girl said?
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Why would that Arbiter twist everything we have endured?
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Ha, haha. Looking at my trousers?
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: It's fine, look as much as you like. It's not going to bring my shins back.
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Bozhe moi...
attributes.name: Handsome Nobleman

attributes.content: Varvara... This is... O, bozhe moi!
attributes.name: Handsome Nobleman

attributes.content: The votes been tallied yet?
attributes.name: 'Council of Sixteen' Thug A

attributes.content: Yeah.
attributes.name: 'Council of Sixteen' Thug B

attributes.content: The boss decided that, from now on, we're the 'Sixteen Warriors'.
attributes.name: 'Council of Sixteen' Thug B

attributes.content: But why?! I read in an old book that the first sixteen to follow Igor Velikiy got a title that meant 'councilmember', so 'Council' is the only choice!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Shut up about your stupid theories... Besides, if we're a 'Council', then we gotta respect a vote, right? Right now everyone thinks 'Warriors' sounds better.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: Blyat. I get less and less happy making this money.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: It's not just the name change. Now we suddenly need to keep track of our results, see who can handle the most kids...
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Enough whining. Saw you slacking off yesterday, you want the boss to scream his head off at you?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: Shut up. I sent one of them off last night.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Who?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: The one who said he was 'pure Grypherburger stock', Leonid Gelashvili or something.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: I checked some Grypherburg copies of the Almanac of Nobility, didn't see the family there. Then I decided to check some chronicles. Turns out, they're just an ordinary family from the south.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: The boss only wanted real nobles, so I handled him.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: *sigh* Why bother going to all that trouble? Could've just listened to his accent. Did he sound like a Grypherburger?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: Accent? I've been shut in this damn place for too long, almost forgot what the locals are supposed to sound like.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Hey, you, you a Grypherburger?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: He gives his seat a pat, and he gets a yelp of fear in return. A student kneels on the ground underneath his buttocks, serving as his chair.
I-I-I-I'm a Grypherburger!
attributes.name: Panicked Student

attributes.content: I've got the accent, I've got family! Please, let me go, gospodin!
attributes.name: Panicked Student

attributes.content: If I remember right... You're not supposed to speak while you're being a chair. The boss is gonna get real mad at me if he sees this.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: So shut your mouth, alright? If you stay nice and quiet for an hour, I won't see you off today.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Alright, enough. These kids don't have it easy, what with you terrorizing them all day.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: You, lecturing me?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: You're the guy who's happy to sit on a stiff corpse.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Upon hearing her comrade's words, the thug pulls her knife out of her 'cushion', warm blood dripping off its blade.
I like sitting cross-legged, doesn't matter to me if they're dead.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: ...Hey, that little countess there? She's dragging some other girl along with her, think she's a noble too—
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: Save your strength, dearie. There's nowhere for you to run with all of us here.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C

attributes.content: No, I beg you—
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: I gave Gromov all my money. He said I'm a noble, and that I'll leave here alive.
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: You gave it to him, but not to me. Besides, I don't care about the money.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C

attributes.content: I only care about order, understand? I'll say it clearly, no fighting in the dorm. Who said you could hit that Symposithingy boy?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C

attributes.content: I didn't hit anyone! I just gave him a push—
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Excuses! I told you kids a thousand times, fighting is wrong! When will you kids actually listen?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C

attributes.content: You need to be punished.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C

attributes.content: ...Punished... what?
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Hey, Warriors! Beat the life outta this spoiled little princess. I'll think of what to say to Gromov.
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug C

attributes.content: You got it!
attributes.name: Everyone

attributes.content: Varvara closes her eyes tight. A gust of wind sweeps by her cheek, and a few drops of warm liquid splash across her forehead.
She shudders as she opens her eyes. The raised stick is gone, along with its master.
Who's next?!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima stands before Varvara, waving about a bloodstained steel pipe as she bellows out her challenge.
There are more footsteps and angry shouts, but they are soon replaced by cries of pain.
Hey! Don't even think about running!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Aren't you guys the Warriors now? How come even an Originium slug can take more punches than you?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: I've got them!
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: We've cut off their escape route too, Sonya! They're not going to get away!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Before long, the nearby Warriors are sprawled out across the ground. Leto pats the dust off her hands, giving one of their heads a good kick before moving back to Sonya's side.
All taken care of, General.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Great! Time for a break.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Zima crouches down, stretching out a hand to Varvara.
Though Zima's face is still stained with blood, it is the face that has brought her the most relief these past few days.
You're... Varvara? There are our people here?
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Chyort... Just how many Vanguards were captured...?
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Not important. Focus on saving people.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Can you still stand, Varvara?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Sonya!
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: *sob*... Sonya, Faddey, I thought I was going to die...
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Do I remember that you're the daughter of a soldier? Dry your tears.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: It's fine, seriously.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Mm... Right.
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Listen, we're here to get everyone back.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Is it just you here? Where are the other students being held?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: They're... They're in the building on the north side.
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Gromov said the 'VIP Lounge' and 'Common Waiting Area' were there. There's still lots of students trapped in there, but I know the way, at least.
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Lead the way.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Varvara tugs on Zima's hand, using her strength to stand. Though she still trembles, the light has returned to her eyes.

It is the light of a drowning girl who has grabbed onto a buoy. Though she does not know what exactly lies behind that door, she believes that as long as Sonya is with her, it is an exit out of this forsaken place.
We've gotten everyone out, General.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Those thugs were pretty much all bark. Most of the people who were captured are still alive, but... they've been through a lot.
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Speaking of the thugs, been a while since we saw them. Almost feels like something's off, haha.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Shut up. You're the only one who likes those bastards.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: This building's too close to the exit. It'll be easy to spot us. We can't wait for everyone to calm down before we act.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Pencil Stub, get everyone organized, then lead the way. Rosalind, hold the rear with me.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Got it, General.
attributes.name: 'Pencil Stub'

attributes.content: Hah. You see? Nicknames are easier to work with, da?
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: The rescued students, several dozen in all, are huddled along the road like canned fins. Some of them had their jackets taken away, their faces streaked with tears.
But with Pencil Stub and his team's coaxing, they slowly stand up and follow their lead, heading towards their camp.
Finally. We're saved.
attributes.name: Rescued Student A

attributes.content: The sun is out. Let's go, quickly. I'd rather die than go back to that blasted place.
attributes.name: Rescued Student B

attributes.content: Wait. What's that sound?
attributes.name: Rescued Student B

attributes.content: Someone's coming. Hide in the buildings, and don't do anything stupid!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Before anyone can react, the Sixteen Warriors appear at the very back of the group, escorting a burly Ursus.
Shrieks break out at the sight of them, and everything immediately devolves into chaos. A few people shout, trying to maintain order, but to no avail.
Stay calm! I'll handle them!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Oh? You must be the Sonya they were talking about.
attributes.name: Burly Ursus

attributes.content: You're pretty small, aren't you? But you sure can fight.
attributes.name: Burly Ursus

attributes.content: You Gromov? What're you doing here?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Haha. Your fellow students were too hasty, forgot a few important things.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Seeing as some people came to the auction, but want to leave without buying a ticket... I've got no choice but to teach them a lesson. Personally.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: There's one part you got wrong. I'm the only one you'll be facing.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Just you?
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: What, scared?
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: That weapon you've got looks like a hammer and an axe had a baby. Fearsome.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Didn't think its master would be a spineless coward.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: ...Pfft. Hahahaha—
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: You're the third one to get a laugh out of me today, little bear. The other two, I already dumped in the snow. They're wishing they had never been born.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Come, take a good look at my weapon!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: What the—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: It is an ebon maw, a voracious abyss.
Are they pushing a... cannon?
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Ready—
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Get to cover!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: The pitch-black muzzle slowly rises, the grinding of gears piercing the silence. Panic breaks out as people scramble to hide themselves where they can, holding their breath as they wait for the cannon's roar.
Run! To the buildings by the road!
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Fire!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: For a moment, all sound is driven out of Katorga. All that remains is a keen ringing in the ears.
Zima pokes her head out of a snowbank, her sight blurred by blood. Though she leapt out of the center of the blast, shrapnel has left a gash across her forehead.
Under a layer of dust, a scorched, black pit mars what was once level ground. Flames climb their way up the wooden doors. Around her, there are the bleeding, the injured, the fallen.
Wh... Why?! Most of us are noble!
attributes.name: Yeremey

attributes.content: Because you pissed me off, you snot-nosed little intellectual.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: There's only one real rule among the Sixteen Warriors: have your last words ready if you ever make me angry!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Ready the second round—
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Get everyone out of here, Rosalind! I'll draw their fire! That's an order!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Dammit!
attributes.name: Leto

attributes.content: Gromov's laughter can still be heard through the artillery barrage. He does not bother aiming, wantonly raining down fire across the area. Watching pathetic insects scurry about is his greatest joy, after all.
The ramshackle buildings sway. Varvara had been through too much today. She stands by a stone pillar, her eyes blank...
Move!
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: AHH!
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: M-My legs, I—
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: Oh, no no no no NO, I can't feel my legs!
attributes.name: Varvara

attributes.content: ...Save it. You're still alive.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Faddey! You're bleeding! I need to—
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: ...No. Don't you get it? Just run.
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Take that Varvara girl with you, and run. All of you. Don't bother about me...
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: I said, RUN!
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Take care, Faddey...
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: Grab onto my shoulders, Varvara. You're still alive, so just hang on—
attributes.name: Nika

attributes.content: As the girls fade into the distance, Faddey lets out a deep breath. The last vestige of his consciousness is beginning to scatter.
...So that's what it feels like... to get something done... to be a hero...
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: The perfect time... for graduation day...
attributes.name: Faddey

attributes.content: Ahh... Feels good to let out all that pent-up frustration that's been building up these past few days.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Keep going, don't give them any time to breathe.
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Alright, I'm on—ARGH!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug A

attributes.content: Gromov leaps aside as a crossbow bolt sprouts out of his lackey's chest. He looks towards its source: a high-rise, from which more bolts are coming.
The Unbound? It's that Antosha again!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: C'mon, keep loading more shells! I'll bury him along with the students!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Gromov! Stop!
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Your reckless actions have alarmed Gospodin Pavlovich, and he demands that you cease firing at once. If you dare hurt another noble, he'll have your hide!
attributes.name: Security Team Captain

attributes.content: Hey, Boss... Do we retreat?
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: Retreat? Forgotten how to fight without a cannon, have we?
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Go catch Antosha! If you don't deal with him, it'll be your hides on the line!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: Now get lost!
attributes.name: Gromov

attributes.content: You got it!
attributes.name: 'Sixteen Warriors' Thug B

attributes.content: People covered in bandages throng around tonight's bonfires, repeating their experiences today to anyone within earshot, relishing in the joy of the survivor.
Leto still has energy to burn, so she and a few students with medical knowledge run around the camp, making themselves useful.
As for Nika, Yeremey and Pencil Stub, they sit together in silence, fidgeting with the firewood.
Varvara lies in a deep sleep after receiving treatment. She dreams of the parts of her body she has lost forever... as well as her peers, also gone for good.
The noble girl's alright now. Matvey has brought people to look after her and the other wounded.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Thank you. No amount of thanks could express what we feel. Matvey and the others are professionals when it comes to treating wounds. The Unbound has done so much for us.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Heh. Those non-producing nobles will never understand that workers are far more capable than they are. Even if you start with no skills, as long as you want to survive, Ursus will always 'teach' you.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: That's why I can't understand why you'd waste medicine and energy on these people. They're not worth the effort.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I was the one who took them with me, and I promised them I'd bring everyone back. I saved a few people, but others... They believed in me, but they couldn't come back with us.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Either way, you did all you could. The camp here is much more crowded. You brought back most of them. Mission accomplished.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: But I still have to warn you. Don't expect anything from those spoiled princelings and princesses. There might come a day when you regret saving their sorry hides.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Don't try and deny it, Sonya. You and I both know how few nobles there are who recognize the need to fight for themselves. You should rely on people with more determination.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: You're wrong, Antosha.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Look at the faces around the bonfire. Doesn't matter if they're noble or common, there's always someone with their fists clenched tight.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: As long as they haven't given up on resisting, as long as the fire still burns inside them... I won't turn my back on anyone.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: I need them. They can become fighters.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You're delusional.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: There's only ever a small subsection of the people who are actually decisive. You should pick a team of smart, hard-working, ordinary students, and come with me.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Once we get rid of the two in charge, we'll be out of here quick.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Thanks, Antosha, but I've already made my decision.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: When the crisis hits, no one can stay out of it. I will turn them into a real unit. No one gets left behind.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Doesn't matter if it's Gromov, Pavlovich, or those assholes pushing the cannon while they look down on us—
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: We'll knock them all to the ground!
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Today's operation might've given you prestige, but it's also given you blind faith.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I don't understand how those soft-handed weaklings who can't even hold a weapon tight are meant to take down those madmen, and that cannon.
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: As long as they can walk and make a fist, they can do it. I'll start by teaching them how to march.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Past experience tells me that, with the right tactics, even a weakling can be worth ten men.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: As for the cannon, all we can do is wait for the right opportunity. We can't take it head-on, for now at least.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Maybe... My friends can bring us some opportunities.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: Your friends? The ones outside Katorga?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: Yeah.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: How can you be so sure they're working on helping you?
attributes.name: Antosha

attributes.content: I've got absolutely zero doubt they are.
attributes.name: Zima

attributes.content: You can't imagine the things we've been through together.
attributes.name: Zima
